[{"id": "nnvMTG5Sl5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\ude4fPrayer Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "B-CtTCmVDX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The prayers module helps gather, track and manage prayers and prayer requests.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "hkZGijObDP", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Prayers workspace starts with the requests that wait for you. Urgent Prayer Requests lists the open urgent requests. Awaiting Approval lists the requests that wait for approval before the prayer team or the church can see them. Ending This Week lists the open requests whose End Date is in the next 7 days, the soonest first. Under them, the graph shows the active requests by type. The other prayer reports are in the Reports folder of the Prayers sidebar.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "w8oEjl0tNc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\ude47Prayer Request", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t25CxbBSfh", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayer requests are made by (and prayed for) by church people. Prayer requests can also be submitted via users on the site or anonymously via a web form.
The Prayer Request list shows the newest requests first, with the Status, Prayer For, Type, Who Can See It, Urgent and Times Prayed For. Requested shows orange, Being Prayed For blue and Answered green. Type a name in the Prayer For box to find the requests for a person.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "prayer_status_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Status. Only a Church Manager or Church Pastoral Care can change the status of a prayer request. A new request starts as Requested. Members, staff and the prayer team can see the status but cannot change it, on the website or in the desk.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "vKO4mgte4s", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a prayer request, note the following:
- Additional prayer request statuses can be created if needed.
- Additional prayer request types can be created if needed.
- If the request is for a specific person, pick them in 'Prayer For'. Leave it blank for a general request. To pray for another kind of record, such as a Missionary, change 'Prayer For Type' first.
- Type the request in 'Request', under these fields.
- 'Approved for List' and 'End Date' are in the 'Listing and Expiry' section. It opens by itself when the request is not approved for the list or has an End Date. After the End Date the request leaves the prayer lists.
- 'Who Can See It' controls who sees the request:
    - Private: only the person who made it and the pastoral care team (Church Pastoral Care, Church Manager and System Manager users).
    - Prayer Team: also the prayer team.
    - Whole Church: also every member, on the Community Prayer Requests page. Only these requests can go in a bulletin.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "prayer_approve_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Requests from the anonymous form. A request from the anonymous web form does not show on the Community Prayer Requests page or in a bulletin until staff approve it. To approve it, open the Prayer Request and tick Approved for List in the Listing and Expiry section, which is open on a request that waits. Only Church Manager and Church Pastoral Care users can change this box. To find the requests that wait, click Awaiting Approval in the Prayers sidebar or on the Prayers workspace. To approve many requests at one time, select them, click Edit, set Approved for List and click Update. A request is also removed from the page and from new bulletins when its status is Answered, Archived or Closed, or when its End Date is past.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "prayer_team_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayer team. To add a person to the prayer team, open their user and give it the Church Prayer Team role. On the Community Prayer Requests page, a member of the prayer team sees the Prayer Team requests and the Whole Church requests, and can pray for them. A staff user with this role also sees these requests in the Prayer Request list. The prayer team does not see the Private requests of other people.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "prayer_notify_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Who hears of a new request. When someone adds a prayer request, Churchit sends an email and a desk notification. A request that is not Private goes to the Pastoral Care team and the Church Managers of its church, and to the Prayer Team when the request is approved for the list. A request from a guest on the website waits for approval. When you approve it, the Prayer Team gets one email about it. A Private request goes only to the Pastoral Care team and the Church Managers, and the email does not show what the request says. To change who gets these emails or what they say, open Notification and edit New Prayer Request for the Prayer Team, Approved Prayer Request for the Prayer Team or New Private Prayer Request.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "prayer_count_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayed count. Each prayer request shows how many times people prayed for it, in the Times Prayed For field and in the Prayed column of the Community Prayer Requests page. A prayer from the community page, or a Prayer record that names the request, adds one. A Prayer that names the same request two times counts one time. When you delete a Prayer or move it to a different request, the count changes. The count does not change the Last Updated time of the request.
Other members cannot open or pray for a request that is closed, answered, archived or not approved, or whose end date has passed. The member who made the request can still open it and pray for it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "jBxW6do4OH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83e\udd32Prayers", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Wh1jXU5eeV", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayers are offered by church people. Prayers may be related to prayer requests.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "AT0xpnyfrl", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a prayer, note the following:
- Select the person who is saying the prayer. With more than one church, the person must belong to your church.
- A file can be attached if the prayer is a written or recorded prayer.
- Items that were prayed for can be recorded in the 'Prayer Topics' section.
    - Topics can include anything stored in the system (i.e. People, Events, Missionaries, Prayer Requests, etc).
    - Choose the topic type (i.e. Prayer Request), then choose the specific document of that type. You can choose only a prayer request that you can open.
- A Prayer is titled with the name of the person who prayed and the day, such as 'James Wilson, 2026-10-20'. The Prayers list shows the newest first. Use the Person box to see one person's prayers.", "col": 12}}]
